f.t: The band was founded by then-husband-and-wife Rob Kolar and Lauren Brown, who had both been members of the folk group He’s My Brother She’s My Sister.
f.q: KOLARS was a Los Angeles-based band founded by then-husband-and-wife Rob Kolar and Lauren Brown, both former members of folk group He's My Brother She's My Sister.

f.t: They played over 400 shows, including SXSW, Treefort Festival, The Great Escape and Cornbury, before breaking up in 2021.
f.q: The band played over 400 shows, including appearances at several music festivals: SXSW, Treefort Festival, Rolling Stone Weekender, London Calling, Gasparilla, Cornbury, Savannah Stopover, Dot to Dot, The Great Escape. They broke up in 2021.

f.t: Their sound was described as Desert Disco, Space Blues and Glamabilly; Paste said they blended 70s glam rock, 90s grunge and twangy country.
f.q: Their sound was described as Desert Disco, Space Blues and Glamabilly. ... Paste wrote that "KOLARS play their unique blend of 70s glam rock, 90s grunge and twangy country with every inch of their body"
